THIS SHEET IS FRAMES 0–5 OF A 24-FRAME 360 SPIN. Strict row-major angles: top row 0°,15°,30°; bottom row 45°,60°,75°. 0° is exactly FRONT. Gradually turn the whole rigidly posed garment toward its LEFT PROFILE; at 75° it is nearly a thin left-side silhouette. These must be six DISTINCT regularly stepped views, not duplicated front views. Camera remains level at garment center and static; Y/Oy axis perfectly vertical. No pitch/roll/upward camera tilt, no changing sleeve pose, no changing garment shape. No fake flat-image skew. Show physically correct side thickness and occlusion while preserving all cotton folds, trim widths and branding placement. High quality original AI catalog photography style.
